planets.name: HD 25463 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 25463 with a 7.05-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 25463 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 25463. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
